card.title: RED BULL
card.text: At the start of your turn, double the attack of this unit.
card.flavorText: The 34th Infantry Division, nicknamed the “Red Bull” Division, was the first US division deployed to Europe in WWII. It shipped for Northern Ireland in early 1942, beginning a long journey that would carry it from North Africa to northern Italy. In the Tunisian campaign, the division engaged Axis forces in rugged terrain and helped secure the final Allied victory there in 1943. From September 1943, the Red Bull Division took part in the Allied invasion of mainland Italy. It advanced through Naples, Rome, and the Arno River valley before fighting in the Apennine Mountains. The division played a key role in breaching German defenses during the final push into the Po Valley in 1945. The 34th suffered heavy casualties during the Italian Campaign but developed a reputation for toughness. The division’s shoulder patch, a red steer skull over a black water jug, was inspired by a soldier’s design from its 1917 training days in New Mexico.
